fields.root_cause: Not a schema or connector failure - Supabase writes and ServiceMinder reads both verified working live end-to-end. call_notes/contacts (steps 4d.1-4d.3): the daily routine appears to silently skip these writes - 16 legitimate Perceptionist notes flowed Jul28-Aug15 with zero landing in call_notes (0 rows ever), so this predates and is separate from the Aug16-24 forwarding gap. appointments (5c) stale since ~7/12 despite both dependencies now verified healthy - most likely the single long combined daily prompt (7 major steps) is running out of turns/budget before reaching 4d/5c/6, or erroring earlier without surfacing it. Recommend: split the routine into smaller scheduled steps or add an end-of-run row-count assertion per table so a silent skip fails loudly instead of reporting all-clear; re-run bootstrap.sh and confirm a fresh ServiceMinder MCP connection is picked up before relying on find_appointment; add a unique index on call_notes for Interaction-ID dedup; and Aug16-24 Perceptionist silence needs its own urgent degradation callout today, not an all-clear.
fields.perceptionist: rows=0 last 7d; NOT a route failure - Gmail/firstgentalent connection verified healthy (general inbox returns mail fine). 30d window found 16 legit forwards, steady Jul28-Aug15, then an abrupt 9-day silence Aug16-24. Upstream forwarding gap (Perceptionist or staff-forward), not Zapier/Gmail.

fields.detail: Live check of the Closebot agency API (GET /agency/source, agency agn_TDG3VN71BCI35XN7) returned 8 sources for what should be two locations. Bath Tune-Up (0uWA8M5BzHrrcJftuaDe) has FIVE separate source records: src_16VMHVU5CCOHPAC7, src_24WVSJQXITOFM74O, src_K33N5LIO2QBMW3PN, src_L3IGFL677FXL3N5D, src_QB34844K4VMV14RK. Kitchen Tune-Up (nHLCxHPidnhV1NFzRtZZ) has two: src_L620TCZJBOL15MOG (named) and src_X6UYDWSPPFPH2M9O (name is null). The eighth is a webhook source, Text Campaign - House Mag. Duplicate sources per location risk double-handling inbound conversations and make bot-attribution ambiguous. Each source also carries its own GHL OAuth access token with conversations.write / contacts.write / calendars.write scope, so every redundant source is an extra live credential. Recommend consolidating BTU to one source, naming or removing the unnamed KTU source, and confirming which sourceId the booking bot actually runs on before deleting anything.
